global_caption: The video contains 9 shots. It is a realistic, cool-toned home fitness tutorial set in a clean, organized home gym room. The lighting primarily uses natural light from the window, supplemented by soft indoor fill light. The visuals are clean and controlled, with clear and crisp camera movement that is brisk but not rushed. The entire video features Chinese The emotional tone remains consistently positive, strong, and stable throughout.
shot1: Shot 1 opens with a fade-in into a wide eye-level composition. Foreground shows the laid-out yoga mat, mid-ground features a young woman standing at the center of the mat, background includes the window-side training area, dumbbell rack, and resistance bands. Window frame and floor lines form natural leading lines, focusing on the relationship between the subject and the training space. Cool morning light enters from the side-rear, outlining the subject’s silhouette and equipment edges.
shot2: Shot 2 hard cuts from previous shot to a close-up eye-level view, framing the upper body and abdominal region. Subject is positioned slightly off-center in a third-rule composition, background blurred but retaining window outline. Lighting remains cool natural light with soft fill. She demonstrates proper stance while clearly explaining “脚踩稳，收腹，肩膀放松，吸气准备”.
shot3: Shot 3 hard cuts to an extreme close-up eye-level shot, focusing on shoulder-neck and arm range of motion. Background depth of field is shallower, with cool window light creating thin contour lines on skin edges. She begins shoulder-neck circles and arm-opening warm-up, first slowly rotating shoulders, then opening arms outward. Movements are smooth and rhythmically steady. The camera makes small lateral follow movements to keep joint actions centered.
shot4: Shot 4 hard cuts to a medium eye-level shot, showing full-body in frame. Foreground retains minimal floor space for depth, background remains clean gym room with cool natural window light. Focus is on hip-knee-ankle coordination. She fully demonstrates squats: hinging hips back, lowering slowly, pausing, then rising upright. Knee trajectory is stable without inward collapse. She emphasizes “下蹲吸气，起身呼气，膝盖跟脚尖方向一致” in Camera slightly tilts down then up, following center-of-mass shift.
shot5: Shot 5 connects via smooth transition hard cut to a medium lateral pan shot. Subject moves to mirror area. Mirror in background reflects body side profile, creating dual foreground-background observation. Focus locks on front knee, toe direction, and trunk stability. Cool lighting remains consistent, with only soft reflection at mirror edge. She steps forward into lunge, bending front and back legs sequentially before returning to standing. Movement repeats once to reinforce learning. Camera laterally follows, showing both front and side posture.
shot6: Shot 6 transitions via quick downward cut to an overhead shot. Viewpoint directly above the mat. Mat edges and hand-elbow positions form clear geometric composition. Subject’s body occupies vertical axis. Focus precisely on elbow-shoulder-back alignment. Natural light from one side casts diagonal shadows on mat, revealing true texture. She lowers into plank position: elbows down, shoulders aligned, core engaged, body straight from head to heels. Camera maintains slight pitch adjustment to keep key support points visible.
shot7: Shot 7 hard cuts to a close-up low-angle shot from front-side. Shallow depth of field blurs background equipment. Focus follows knee advancement and flat back posture. Cool lighting unchanged, but ground reflects subtle bright strip. She begins slow mountain climbers, alternating legs forward, maintaining steady pace. Shoulders remain still, back does not sag. She reminds “慢一点也没关系，腰背不要塌”. Camera performs short push-pull movements to highlight core engagement and control.
shot8: Shot 8 connects via soft fade cut to a medium-wide eye-level shot. Frame pulls back, subject lying supine on mat. Foreground shows raised knees and pelvis, background still reveals window-side training area. Spatial continuity is clear. Focus shifts from glute bridge peak to posterior chain stretch. Cool natural light forms clean bright stripes on floor. She completes one standard glute bridge: lifts pelvis, tightens glutes, pauses, then lowers. Then smoothly transitions into leg hug and hamstring stretch. Movement flow is fluid. She gives brief cue “抬起时夹紧臀部，放下后接腿后侧拉伸”. Camera first slightly pulls back, then stabilizes, making full transition visible. Exhalation synchronizes strictly with lowering and stretching phases.
shot9: Shot 9 fades in to conclude with a close-up eye-level shot by the window. Composition focuses on face, neck, and subtly rising chest. Background is blurred window frame and soft cool daylight. Shallow depth of field makes facial expression the sole focus. Key light remains natural side light, with soft fill preserving skin texture realism. She returns to window, gently places hands, slowly inhales then exhales. Expression is focused and encouraging.
